robust.zh: 穩固的、可靠的（系統、設計）

ex.en: We need a more robust security system.
ex.zh: 我們需要更可靠的安全系統。

ex.en: The software is robust and easy to use.
ex.zh: 這套軟體穩定又好用。

robust.en: strong and not likely to fail

ex.en: The economy showed robust growth last year.
ex.zh: 去年經濟呈現強勁成長。

ex.en: Demand for our products remains robust.
ex.zh: 我們產品的需求依然強勁。

ex.en: Full oxidation gives black tea its deep, robust flavor and dark amber color.
ex.zh: 完全氧化讓紅茶有濃郁醇厚的風味和深琥珀色。

ex.en: This wine has a robust flavor.
ex.zh: 這款紅酒風味濃郁。

robust.en: having a strong, full and pleasant taste

ex.en: The rocket was launched into space.
ex.zh: 火箭被發射到太空。

ex.en: The rocket travels at a tremendous speed.
ex.zh: 火箭飛行的速度極快。

rocket.en: a tube-shaped vehicle that is sent up into space

rocket.zh: rocket science：（多用於否定）高深的學問、難事

ex.en: Connecting a PC to the internet isn't rocket science.
ex.zh: 把電腦連上網路又不是什麼難事。

ex.en: Don't worry, it's not rocket science.
ex.zh: 別擔心，這又不是什麼高深的學問。

rocket.en: something very hard to understand or do

ex.en: Housing prices have rocketed in recent years.
ex.zh: 近年來房價飆升。

ex.en: Sales rocketed after the ad campaign.
ex.zh: 廣告活動之後銷售量暴增。

rocket.en: to go up very quickly and by a large amount

ex.en: The robot went out of control.
ex.zh: 這個機器人失控了。

ex.en: In the future, will robots be as common as personal computers?
ex.zh: 未來，機器人會像個人電腦一樣普及嗎？

ex.en: Each robot is equipped with a talking machine.
ex.zh: 每個機器人身上都裝了一台發聲器。

robot.en: a machine that can do work by itself, often like a person

ex.en: Intel gets a huge royalty from the invention.
ex.zh: 英特爾從那項發明中獲得一大筆權利金。

ex.en: The author receives royalties on every book sold.
ex.zh: 每賣出一本書，作者都能拿到版稅。

royalty.en: money paid to the maker of a book, song or invention each time it is sold or used

ex.en: The hotel has hosted royalty and movie stars.
ex.zh: 這家飯店接待過皇室成員和電影明星。

ex.en: We were treated like royalty at the party.
ex.zh: 我們在派對上受到貴賓級的款待。

ex.en: We routinely check all equipment for safety.
ex.zh: 我們例行檢查所有設備的安全。

ex.en: Staff routinely work late on Fridays.
ex.zh: 員工星期五經常加班到很晚。

routinely.en: as a normal and regular part of what is done

ex.en: What on earth are you doing in my room?
ex.zh: 你到底在我房間裡做什麼？

ex.en: Do you have a room that's a little cheaper?
ex.zh: 你們有便宜一點的房間嗎？

ex.en: Do you have any rooms with a shower and toilet?
ex.zh: 有附淋浴和馬桶的房間嗎？

room.en: a part of a building with its own walls, floor and ceiling

ex.en: Is there room for one more person?
ex.zh: 還有空間再多坐一個人嗎？

ex.en: This sofa takes up too much room.
ex.zh: 這張沙發太佔空間了。

room.en: enough empty space for something or someone

ex.en: Nature plays an important role in our life.
ex.zh: 大自然在我們的生活中扮演重要的角色。

ex.en: My role is to manage the team's schedule.
ex.zh: 我的職責是管理團隊的行程。

ex.en: Social media plays a big role in marketing.
ex.zh: 社群媒體在行銷上扮演重要角色。

role.en: the part that a person or thing has in an activity or situation

ex.en: He will play the leading role for the first time in the next school festival.
ex.zh: 下次校慶時，他將第一次擔任主角。

ex.en: She got the main role in the school play.
ex.zh: 她在學校話劇中拿到主角。

role.en: a character played by an actor

ex.en: The glass from a round table has been smashed.
ex.zh: 一張圓桌的玻璃被打碎了。

ex.en: We sat at a round table.
ex.zh: 我們坐在一張圓桌旁。

round.en: shaped like a circle or a ball

round.zh: all year round：一年到頭、終年

ex.en: This mountain is covered with snow all year round.
ex.zh: 這座山終年積雪。

ex.en: The forests in Taiwan stay green all year round.
ex.zh: 台灣的森林終年常綠。

ex.en: We can enjoy skiing here all the year round.
ex.zh: 我們在這裡一整年都能滑雪。

ex.en: We gave the performer a round of applause.
ex.zh: 我們給表演者一陣掌聲。

ex.en: The candidates passed the first round of interviews.
ex.zh: 候選人通過了第一輪面試。

ex.en: This round of drinks is on me.
ex.zh: 這一輪酒我請客。

round.en: one part of a series of events or actions

ex.en: Please round the number to two decimal places.
ex.zh: 請把數字四捨五入到小數點後兩位。

ex.en: The price was rounded up to 100 dollars.
ex.zh: 價格被進位到一百元。

round.en: to change a number to the nearest simple number

ex.en: This road is too narrow for cars to pass.
ex.zh: 這條路太窄，車子過不去。

ex.en: Look out for cars when you cross the road.
ex.zh: 過馬路時要小心車子。

ex.en: There are a lot of long and straight roads in Hokkaido.
ex.zh: 北海道有很多又長又直的路。

road.en: a hard, wide way for cars and other vehicles to travel on

road.zh: on the road：在路上；在外奔波（出差）

ex.en: Our sales team is on the road most of the month.
ex.zh: 我們的業務團隊一個月大半時間都在外奔波。

ex.en: We've been on the road for six hours.
ex.zh: 我們已經在路上開了六個小時的車。

ex.en: The rocks are weathered into fantastic forms.
ex.zh: 岩石經過風化，形成了奇特的形狀。

ex.en: Don't throw rocks into the river.
ex.zh: 不要往河裡丟石頭。

ex.en: The woman is in front of a big rock.
ex.zh: 那個女人站在一塊大石頭前面。

rock.en: the hard natural material that forms the earth, or a piece of it

ex.en: Jazz fusion is a combination of rock and jazz.
ex.zh: 融合爵士是搖滾樂和爵士樂的結合。

ex.en: They are considered the greatest rock band in history.
ex.zh: 他們被認為是史上最偉大的搖滾樂團。

rock.en: loud popular music with a strong beat, played with guitars and drums

ex.en: She rocked the baby to sleep.
ex.zh: 她搖著寶寶哄他入睡。

ex.en: The boat rocked gently on the waves.
ex.zh: 船在浪上輕輕搖晃。

rock.en: to move gently back and forth or from side to side

ex.en: The children rolled down the hill.
ex.zh: 孩子們從山坡上滾下來。

ex.en: "A rolling stone gathers no moss" is a proverb.
ex.zh: 「滾石不生苔」是一句諺語。

ex.en: The ball rolled under the car.
ex.zh: 球滾到車子底下了。

roll.en: to move along by turning over and over

ex.en: Would you like to eat a roll for lunch?
ex.zh: 你午餐想吃小餐包嗎？

ex.en: Do you know why spring rolls are called spring rolls?
ex.zh: 你知道春捲為什麼叫春捲嗎？

ex.en: We need another roll of toilet paper.
ex.zh: 我們還需要一捲衛生紙。

roll.en: a small round bread, or something wrapped into a tube shape

ex.en: The company will roll out the new app next month.
ex.zh: 公司下個月將推出新 App。

ex.en: The update is being rolled out to all users.
ex.zh: 這次更新正陸續推送給所有使用者。

roll.en: to make a new product or service available for the first time

ex.en: Pull the plant up by the roots.
ex.zh: 把植物連根拔起。

ex.en: The tree's roots go deep into the ground.
ex.zh: 這棵樹的根深入地底。

root.en: the part of a plant that grows under the ground

ex.en: We must get to the root of the problem.
ex.zh: 我們必須找出問題的根源。

ex.en: Poor communication is the root of the problem.
ex.zh: 溝通不良是問題的根源。

root.en: the main cause or beginning of something

root.zh: 根、淵源（複數，如家族、文化的起源）

ex.en: She went back to Taiwan to find her roots.
ex.zh: 她回台灣尋根。

ex.en: Jazz has its roots in African American music.
ex.zh: 爵士樂起源於非裔美國人的音樂。

root.en: the place or family where a person or custom comes from originally

ex.en: The zodiac culture is deeply rooted in people's daily life and linguistic culture.
ex.zh: 生肖文化深深根植於人們的日常生活和語言文化中。

ex.en: The tradition is deeply rooted in local culture.
ex.zh: 這項傳統深植於當地文化。

root.en: to have its start or main cause in something

ex.en: Tom always wants to sit in the front row.
ex.zh: 湯姆總是想坐在第一排。

ex.en: The charge for a front row seat is 5 dollars.
ex.zh: 第一排的座位要五美元。

ex.en: She put her CDs in a row on the shelf.
ex.zh: 她把 CD 在架子上排成一排。

row.en: a line of people or things next to each other

ex.en: It has rained for five days in a row.
ex.zh: 已經連續下了五天的雨。

ex.en: Our team won three games in a row.
ex.zh: 我們隊連贏了三場比賽。

row.en: one after another without a break

ex.en: Let's take turns rowing the boat.
ex.zh: 我們輪流划船吧。

ex.en: We rowed up the river against the current.
ex.zh: 我們在河上逆流划船而上。

row.en: to move a boat through water using long poles with flat ends

ex.en: Tom fixed the roof of his house just yesterday.
ex.zh: 湯姆昨天才修好他家的屋頂。

ex.en: There is a lot of snow on the roof.
ex.zh: 屋頂上積了很多雪。

ex.en: That house with the red roof is Tom's house.
ex.zh: 那棟紅色屋頂的房子是湯姆家。

roof.en: the top outside part that covers a building

ex.en: Ten years after the wedding, everything is just routine.
ex.zh: 結婚十年後，一切都只是例行公事。

ex.en: Exercise is part of my daily routine.
ex.zh: 運動是我每天的例行公事。

routine.en: the usual way of doing things, or a fixed set of daily activities

ex.en: Such questioning is routine police business.
ex.zh: 這樣的訊問只是警方的例行公事。

ex.en: This is just a routine check.
ex.zh: 這只是例行檢查。

routine.en: normal and done regularly, not special

ex.en: The surface of the object is fairly rough.
ex.zh: 這個物體的表面相當粗糙。

ex.en: The skin of a shark is much rougher than that of a tuna fish.
ex.zh: 鯊魚皮比鮪魚皮粗糙多了。

ex.en: At a rough estimate, I would say the job will take two weeks.
ex.zh: 粗略估計，這份工作大概要兩個星期。

ex.en: Can you give me a rough idea of the cost?
ex.zh: 你能告訴我大概要多少錢嗎？

ex.en: I had a rough day at work.
ex.zh: 我今天上班很不順。

ex.en: The company went through a rough year.
ex.zh: 公司度過了艱困的一年。

ex.en: Asia is roughly four times the size of Europe.
ex.zh: 亞洲面積大約是歐洲的四倍。

ex.en: My Chinese is far from perfect, but I can roughly understand everything he is saying.
ex.zh: 我的中文還差得遠，但他說的話我大致都聽得懂。

ex.en: The trip takes roughly two hours.
ex.zh: 這趟路程大約兩個小時。

ex.en: Please don't handle the boxes roughly.
ex.zh: 請不要粗魯地搬這些箱子。

ex.en: He pushed the door open roughly.
ex.zh: 他粗暴地把門推開。

roughly.en: in a way that uses too much force and is not gentle

ex.en: Mary is always saying that Tom isn't romantic enough.
ex.zh: 瑪麗總是說湯姆不夠浪漫。

ex.en: He's a very romantic boyfriend who brings me flowers each night.
ex.zh: 他是個很浪漫的男朋友，每晚都送花給我。

ex.en: Actually I find it quite romantic.
ex.zh: 其實我覺得那很浪漫。

romantic.en: showing or causing strong feelings of love

ex.en: They have a romantic relationship.
ex.zh: 他們是戀愛關係。

ex.en: I prefer romantic comedies to action movies.
ex.zh: 比起動作片，我比較喜歡浪漫喜劇。

romantic.en: related to love between two people

ex.en: Kate has become a full member of the royal family.
ex.zh: 凱特已正式成為王室成員。

ex.en: Sue checked in at the Royal Hotel.
ex.zh: 蘇在皇家飯店辦理入住。

ex.en: Millions of people watched the royal wedding.
ex.zh: 數百萬人收看了這場皇室婚禮。

royal.en: related to a king, a queen or their family

ex.en: The girl brought me a red and a white rose.
ex.zh: 女孩送我一朵紅玫瑰和一朵白玫瑰。

ex.en: The roses in the garden are in flower.
ex.zh: 花園裡的玫瑰正盛開。

ex.en: There is no such thing as a thornless rose.
ex.zh: 沒有不帶刺的玫瑰。

rose.en: a flower with a sweet smell and thorns on its stem

rose.zh: rise 的過去式：上升、上漲；起身

ex.en: Today, the temperature rose as high as 30 degrees Celsius.
ex.zh: 今天氣溫升到攝氏三十度。

ex.en: Sales rose by 15 percent last quarter.
ex.zh: 上一季銷售額成長了百分之十五。

rose.en: to go up, increase or get up (past tense of rise)

ex.en: The rope broke when we were climbing the mountain.
ex.zh: 我們爬山的時候繩子斷了。

ex.en: The rope wasn't strong enough to support him.
ex.zh: 繩子不夠牢固，撐不住他。

ex.en: Tom untied the ropes.
ex.zh: 湯姆解開了繩子。

rope.en: a thick, strong cord made by twisting threads together

rope.zh: learn/know the ropes：熟悉門道、上手

ex.en: It took me a month to learn the ropes at my new job.
ex.zh: 我花了一個月才熟悉新工作。

ex.en: Amy will show you the ropes on your first day.
ex.zh: 你第一天上班時，Amy 會教你怎麼做。

rope.en: to learn or understand how a job or activity is done

ex.en: My manager roped me into organizing the party.
ex.zh: 我主管硬拉我去籌辦派對。

ex.en: We roped in some volunteers to help.
ex.zh: 我們找了一些志工來幫忙。

rope.en: to persuade someone to take part in something

ex.en: The earth rotates once every 24 hours.
ex.zh: 地球每二十四小時自轉一圈。

ex.en: Rotate the image 90 degrees to the right.
ex.zh: 把圖片向右旋轉九十度。

rotate.en: to turn around a central point

ex.en: We rotate the night shift every week.
ex.zh: 我們每週輪流值夜班。

ex.en: New staff rotate between departments to gain experience.
ex.zh: 新進員工在各部門輪調以累積經驗。

rotate.en: to take turns doing a job or having a position

ex.en: The rotation of the earth causes day and night.
ex.zh: 地球自轉造成日夜交替。

ex.en: One full rotation takes about 24 hours.
ex.zh: 自轉一整圈大約需要二十四小時。

rotation.en: the movement of turning around a central point

ex.en: The nurses work in rotation.
ex.zh: 護理師們輪班工作。

ex.en: Crop rotation keeps the soil healthy.
ex.zh: 輪作能讓土壤保持健康。

rotation.en: a system in which people or things take turns

ex.en: Some of the apples in the box were rotten.
ex.zh: 盒子裡的一些蘋果爛了。

ex.en: I cannot fry these eggs. They are rotten.
ex.zh: 這些雞蛋壞掉了，不能拿來煎。

ex.en: The oranges in this bag are rotten.
ex.zh: 這個袋子裡的柳橙都爛了。

rotten.en: bad and no longer good to eat or use because of decay

ex.en: Don't bother Mary; she's in a rotten mood at the moment.
ex.zh: 別打擾瑪麗，她現在脾氣不好。

ex.en: He is rotten to the core.
ex.zh: 他壞透了。

ex.en: I had a rotten day at work and just want to go home.
ex.zh: 我今天上班糟透了，只想回家。

ex.en: This apple is starting to rot.
ex.zh: 這個蘋果開始腐爛了。

ex.en: The fruit rotted quickly.
ex.zh: 水果很快就爛掉了。

ex.en: Eating too much candy can rot your teeth.
ex.zh: 吃太多糖果會蛀壞你的牙齒。

rot.en: to become bad slowly, as food or wood does

ex.en: The builder found signs of rot in the old wooden floor.
ex.zh: 工人發現老舊的木頭地板有腐爛的跡象。

ex.en: Wet leaves on the ground soon turn to rot.
ex.zh: 地上潮溼的落葉很快就會腐爛。

rot.en: the process of going bad, or the damage it causes

ex.en: What is the most convenient route to your place?
ex.zh: 到您那裡哪條路線最方便？

ex.en: Whichever route you take, you will get there in time.
ex.zh: 不管你選哪條路，你都能按時到那裡。

ex.en: Luckily, we found an escape route.
ex.zh: 幸好我們找到了一條逃生路線。

route.en: the way you take to get from one place to another

ex.en: The supervisor posted next month’s shift roster in the staff room.
ex.zh: 主管把下個月的輪班表貼在員工休息室。

ex.en: Two nurses swapped shifts, so the roster needs an update.
ex.zh: 兩位護理師調換了班，值班表需要更新。

roster.en: a list showing people's names and when they must work

ex.en: The product roadmap shows which features will be released in each quarter.
ex.zh: 產品發展藍圖列出各項功能預計在哪一季推出。

ex.en: The board asked for a clear roadmap for reducing operating costs.
ex.zh: 董事會要求提出明確的營運成本降低計畫。

roadmap.en: a plan that shows the steps to reach a goal

ex.en: The university offers a course in robotics.
ex.zh: 這所大學開設機器人技術課程。

ex.en: Robotics is changing the way factories operate.
ex.zh: 機器人技術正在改變工廠的運作方式。

robotics.en: the study and use of machines that can do work by themselves

ex.en: How can a router be used to limit network speed?
ex.zh: 如何使用路由器限制網路速度？

ex.en: The router needs a firmware update.
ex.zh: 這台路由器需要更新韌體。

router.en: a device that sends internet signals to computers in a home or office

ex.en: Roadwork near the station will continue through Friday.
ex.zh: 車站附近的道路施工將持續到週五。

ex.en: Allow extra travel time because of overnight roadwork.
ex.zh: 夜間道路施工，請預留較多交通時間。

roadwork.en: repair or building work on a road

ex.en: My roommate and I split the utility bills every month.
ex.zh: 我和室友每月分攤水電費。

ex.en: Her new roommate works at the hospital nearby.
ex.zh: 她的新室友在附近的醫院工作。

roommate.en: a person you share a room or home with

ex.en: We ordered room service because we were too tired to go out.
ex.zh: 我們太累了不想出門，所以叫了客房服務。

ex.en: Room service is available 24 hours a day.
ex.zh: 客房服務 24 小時提供。

room service.en: a hotel service that brings meals and drinks to guests where they sleep

ex.en: Please give me a round-trip ticket to Chicago.
ex.zh: 請給我一張到芝加哥的來回票。

ex.en: Did you buy a round-trip ticket?
ex.zh: 你買了來回票嗎？

ex.en: What's the round-trip fare?
ex.zh: 來回票多少錢？

round-trip.en: for a journey to a place and back again

ex.en: Take the second exit at the roundabout.
ex.zh: 在圓環走第二個出口。

ex.en: There's a roundabout just after the bridge.
ex.zh: 過橋後馬上有一個圓環。

roundabout.en: a circular place where roads meet and cars go around in one direction

ex.en: He asked in a roundabout way whether I was single.
ex.zh: 他拐彎抹角地問我是不是單身。

ex.en: Don't be so roundabout. Just tell me.
ex.zh: 別拐彎抹角了，直接告訴我吧。

roundabout.en: not direct, and using more words or steps than needed

ex.en: He packed his fishing rod and went to the river.
ex.zh: 他收好釣竿，前往河邊。

ex.en: The curtain hangs from a metal rod above the window.
ex.zh: 窗簾掛在窗戶上方的金屬桿上。

ex.en: A robin sat on the fence and sang in the morning.
ex.zh: 一隻知更鳥停在籬笆上，在早晨唱歌。

ex.en: The robin built a nest in the tree outside our window.
ex.zh: 那隻知更鳥在我們窗外的樹上築了巢。

ex.en: Their romance began at a summer camp.
ex.zh: 他們的戀情始於一個夏令營。

ex.en: The film is a sweet romance set in Paris.
ex.zh: 這部電影是一部發生在巴黎的甜蜜愛情片。

ex.en: Candles and music added romance to the evening.
ex.zh: 蠟燭和音樂為夜晚增添浪漫氣氛。

ex.en: He thinks the romance has gone out of their marriage.

ex.zh: 房東派人來除掉那些蟑螂。

ex.en: Check the rota to see when you are working next week.
ex.zh: 看一下值班表，確認你下週什麼時候上班。

ex.en: We share the cleaning on a weekly rota.
ex.zh: 我們按每週輪值表分擔打掃工作。

ex.en: She held a rosary and prayed quietly.
ex.zh: 她握著念珠安靜地祈禱。

ex.en: The old woman said the rosary every evening.
ex.zh: 那位老太太每天晚上都念玫瑰經。

ex.en: The experts joined a roundtable discussion on education.
ex.zh: 專家們參加了一場關於教育的圓桌討論。

ex.en: A roundtable meeting gives everyone an equal voice.
ex.zh: 圓桌會議讓每個人都有平等的發言權。

ex.en: We sat by a roaring fire.
ex.zh: 我們坐在熊熊燃燒的爐火旁。

ex.en: The roaring waves kept us awake.
ex.zh: 轟隆作響的海浪讓我們睡不著。

ex.en: The new cafe was a roaring success.
ex.zh: 這家新咖啡店大獲成功。

ex.en: He did a roaring trade selling umbrellas in the rain.
ex.zh: 下雨天他賣雨傘生意興隆。

ex.en: The roaring of the crowd shook the stadium.
ex.zh: 群眾的吼聲震動了整座體育場。

ex.en: We heard a roaring in the distance.
ex.zh: 我們聽見遠處傳來轟鳴聲。

ex.en: The rotating door at the hotel moves very slowly.
ex.zh: 那間飯店的旋轉門轉得很慢。

ex.en: We have a rotating schedule, so everyone works weekends sometimes.
ex.zh: 我們採輪班制，所以每個人偶爾都要上週末班。

ex.en: The rowdy crowd outside the stadium was loud all night.
ex.zh: 體育場外吵鬧的人群整晚喧嘩。

ex.en: The teacher asked the rowdy boys to sit down.
ex.zh: 老師要那些吵鬧的男孩坐下。

ex.en: A few rowdies were asked to leave the bar.
ex.zh: 幾個吵鬧的人被請出酒吧。

ex.en: The security guard kept an eye on the rowdies at the back.
ex.zh: 保全留意著後排那些鬧事的人。

ex.en: I read a news roundup every morning before work.
ex.zh: 我每天早上上班前都會看新聞彙整。

ex.en: The magazine published a roundup of the best films of the year.
ex.zh: 那本雜誌刊出了年度最佳電影的綜合介紹。

ex.en: Romanticism was an artistic movement of the nineteenth century.
ex.zh: 浪漫主義是十九世紀的一種藝術運動。

ex.en: Many poems of that period are full of romanticism and love of nature.
ex.zh: 那個時期的許多詩作充滿浪漫主義和對自然的熱愛。

ex.en: The winner pinned a blue rosette to her jacket.
ex.zh: 優勝者把一個藍色的花形徽章別在外套上。

ex.en: A stone rosette decorated the front of the old church.
ex.zh: 舊教堂的正面裝飾著一個石造的圓花飾。

ex.en: The roofing on the old barn needs to be replaced.
ex.zh: 那間舊穀倉的屋頂材料需要更換了。

ex.en: He works in roofing and spends most days outdoors.
ex.zh: 他從事屋頂工程，大部分的時間都在戶外。

ex.en: The storm began to roil the water of the bay.
ex.zh: 暴風雨開始攪動海灣的水。

ex.en: The news continued to roil the markets.
ex.zh: 這則消息持續擾動市場。

roadshow.zh: 巡迴演出；巡迴宣傳活動

ex.en: The band is going on a roadshow across the country.
ex.zh: 這個樂團要展開全國巡迴演出。

ex.en: The company held a roadshow to meet investors in several cities.
ex.zh: 公司舉辦路演，在幾個城市與投資人見面。

ex.en: The chickens went back to their roost at dusk.
ex.zh: 天黑時，雞群回到牠們的棲木上。

ex.en: Hundreds of birds gathered at the roost.
ex.zh: 數百隻鳥聚集在棲息處。

ex.en: Crows roost in the tall trees by the river.
ex.zh: 烏鴉棲息在河邊的高樹上。

ex.en: The birds roosted on the wire all night.
ex.zh: 鳥兒整晚棲息在電線上。

rousing.zh: 激動人心的；令人振奮的

ex.en: The coach gave a rousing speech before the match.
ex.zh: 教練在比賽前發表了鼓舞人心的演說。

ex.en: The band ended the show with a rousing song.
ex.zh: 樂團以一首令人振奮的歌曲結束了演出。

ex.en: A roving reporter asked people about the new law.
ex.zh: 一位四處採訪的記者詢問大家對新法律的看法。

ex.en: The band gave a roving performance through the market.
ex.zh: 樂團在市場裡邊走邊進行流動演出。

ex.en: He learned the multiplication table by rote.
ex.zh: 他靠死記硬背學會了乘法表。

ex.en: Learning by rote is not always the best way to study.
ex.zh: 死記硬背並不一定是最好的學習方式。

ex.en: He moved his rook across the board to attack.
ex.zh: 他把城堡棋子移過棋盤發動攻擊。

ex.en: A rook can move in straight lines along rows and columns.
ex.zh: 城堡棋子可以沿著橫排和直排直線移動。

ex.en: The shop tried to rook tourists by charging double.
ex.zh: 那家店想用兩倍價格敲遊客竹槓。

ex.en: He was rooked out of his savings by a fake investor.
ex.zh: 他被一個假投資人騙走了積蓄。

ex.en: He lost all his money playing roulette at the casino.
ex.zh: 他在賭場玩輪盤賭，輸光了所有的錢。

ex.en: In roulette, players bet on where a small ball will land.
ex.zh: 在輪盤賭中，玩家押注小球會落在哪個位置。

ex.en: The ball rolled under the sofa and I couldn't find it.
ex.zh: 球滾到沙發底下，我找不到它。

ex.en: She rolled the dough into a thin circle.
ex.zh: 她把麵糰擀成薄薄的圓形。

ex.en: He walked in with a rolled newspaper under his arm.
ex.zh: 他腋下夾著一份捲起來的報紙走進來。

ex.en: Put the rolled towels into the basket by the pool.
ex.zh: 把捲好的毛巾放進泳池邊的籃子裡。

ex.en: People often romanticize the past and forget its hardships.
ex.zh: 人們常把過去美化，忘了當時的艱苦。

ex.en: Movies tend to romanticize life in small villages.
ex.zh: 電影往往會把鄉村生活浪漫化。

ex.en: Don't romanticize the idea of living alone before you try it.
ex.zh: 在親身嘗試前，別把獨居的生活想得太浪漫。

ex.en: His fear of dogs is deeply rooted in childhood.
ex.zh: 他對狗的恐懼深植於童年。

ex.en: The tree is firmly rooted in the ground.
ex.zh: 這棵樹牢牢地紮根在土裡。

ex.en: They walked romantically along the beach at sunset.
ex.zh: 他們在日落時浪漫地沿著海灘散步。

ex.en: He is romantically involved with a coworker.
ex.zh: 他和一位同事有感情往來。

ex.en: She romantically imagined life on a quiet island.
ex.zh: 她充滿浪漫幻想地想像著小島上的生活。

ex.en: He spoke romantically about the good old days.
ex.zh: 他浪漫化地談起過去的美好時光。

ex.en: The proposal was roundly criticized by the public.
ex.zh: 這項提案受到大眾嚴厲批評。

ex.en: Our team was roundly beaten in the final.
ex.zh: 我們隊在決賽中被徹底擊敗。

ex.en: The puppies romp in the garden every morning.
ex.zh: 小狗們每天早上都在花園裡嬉戲玩耍。

ex.en: Children romped through the sprinkler on the hot day.
ex.zh: 天氣熱，孩子們在灑水器間嬉鬧。

ex.en: The kids had a happy romp in the snow.
ex.zh: 孩子們在雪地裡開心地玩鬧。

ex.en: Our team won in an easy romp, 5 to 0.
ex.zh: 我們隊輕鬆地以五比零獲勝。

ex.en: Visitors gathered in the rotunda beneath the dome.
ex.zh: 遊客聚集在圓頂下的圓形大廳。

ex.en: The museum's rotunda is used for large events.
ex.zh: 博物館的圓形大廳用來舉辦大型活動。

ex.en: We rented a rowboat and paddled across the lake.
ex.zh: 我們租了一艘划艇划過湖面。

ex.en: The old man kept a small rowboat tied to the dock.
ex.zh: 老先生在碼頭邊繫著一艘小划艇。

ex.en: She spoke to a roomful of students.
ex.zh: 她對著滿屋子的學生演講。

ex.en: A roomful of guests sang happy birthday.
ex.zh: 滿屋子的賓客一起唱生日快樂歌。

ex.en: The store announced a rollback of prices on school supplies.
ex.zh: 商店宣布學用品降價回調。

ex.en: Many voters demanded a rollback of the new tax.
ex.zh: 許多選民要求撤回這項新稅。

ex.en: The machine uses a rotational motion to mix the paint.
ex.zh: 這台機器利用旋轉運動來攪拌油漆。

ex.en: The team has a rotational schedule for cleaning duty.
ex.zh: 團隊以輪流的方式排定打掃值日。

ex.en: Everyone was happy, so I didn't want to rock the boat.
ex.zh: 大家都很開心，所以我不想興風作浪。

ex.en: He never rocks the boat at work and just follows the rules.
ex.zh: 他在工作上從不惹事，只是遵守規定。

rock the boat.en: to cause trouble by changing a stable situation
